key_insight: For a class of semi-linear PDEs, the paper proves that DGM and PINN training by gradient descent converges to the true PDE solution rather than just a local minimum.
engineering_relevance: This gives a mathematical guarantee for scientific machine learning solvers, strengthening confidence in PINNs/DGM for engineering PDE simulation and inverse problems.
method: Formulate PDE solving as minimizing the neural network PDE residual.
Analyze gradient-descent training dynamics for DGM/PINN under a semi-linear PDE setting.
Prove convergence of the learned network toward the PDE solution.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical convergence proof for neural networks trained with gradient descent on the PDE residual objective; no experimental data are mentioned.
watch_item: The guarantee is stated only for a specific class of semi-linear PDEs, so applicability may be limited for more general nonlinear or fully nonconvex PDE settings.
paper_title: Global Convergence of DGM and PINN Algorithms for Solving Nonlinear PDEs
